# shamil

- Site: https://shamilkotta.com/

## Projects

- [nlite](https://shamilkotta.com/projects/nlite): a React 19 framework on Vite with Next.js-style app/ routing, SSR, SSG, and Partial Prerendering, with adapters for Vercel, Cloudflare, and Netlify. Source: https://github.com/shamilkotta/nlite
- [Floate](https://floate.app): a Mac app by shamil.
- [All projects](https://shamilkotta.com/projects): the full list, including npm packages, a browser extension, and an Obsidian plugin.
